title: Negative results and replications
scope: Research-only claim, attempt, outcome, editorial-event and version relationships from published metadata and bounded paper evidence. Indexed-primary-only limits remain explicit. No source corpus, participant row, operational prompt or source code is included.
source_snapshot_limit: No exact upstream paper/HTML byte identity is claimed; source versions, locators, access limits and exact repository revision references are retained.
third_party_rights: Original factual research metadata does not extend third-party source grants. Version-local paper rights and separate code, data, annotation and output rights remain explicit.
verdict: Retain eight collections: three new families and five enrichments against current catalogs. MLRC reports, StrongREJECT and Crossref editorial links have the highest scientific starting value. The smallest structured step reuses CRP006 for one verified editorial chain; it remains a specification only.

interpretation_guards: Separate original claim, replication attempt, scientific outcome, editorial action and document version.
Completed experiments that do not support a particular claim are not universal paper disproof; changed conditions remain explicit.
A null/nonsignificant estimate does not establish equivalence or zero effect. No attempt found is not failed replication.
Reanalysis, rescoring, new annotators on existing outputs and independent new-data replication are different designs.
Keep publisher/evaluator/author attribution and methodological criticism work-scoped; no author-level misconduct inference.
Publications, mirrors, metadata assertions and syntheses are not additional experiments.
Keep source precision, native metrics, denominators, uncertainty type and version-local rights.
Publication/cohort/deposit/retrieval dates are not execution dates; unknown dates remain null.
Selected negative cases/register counts are not population failure rates. No universal capability/productivity curve or p(doom) conversion.
No bulk corpora, participant-level rows, operational attack content or source code execution.

novelty_summary.basis: Current 64-source inventory and relevant research catalogs at the reviewed repository commit.

numeric_representation: Reported decimal metric values and intervals are lexical strings to preserve displayed precision; counts, thresholds and numeric protocol controls retain their stated primitive types. No numeric result was recalculated.

corrections.finding: Against current catalogs, retain three new families and five enrichments. ReScience/MLRC, Crossref, arXiv and METR productivity already have family or study records; the initial five-new/three-enrichment classification requires revision.
LICO replication’s 78.1 versus 77.3 is a within-replication baseline/treatment pair; original full-label CIFAR-100 is 80.9 versus 82.2. Preserve architecture-label conflict and unnamed ± statistic.
Official proceedings/repository label the LICO cohort 2023; arXiv says MLRC 2024. The archive span does not prove one completed cohort each year.

StrongREJECT reruns one illustrative example three times; this neither reevaluates all 520 original instructions nor revises the 43.08% full-benchmark rate. The separate 313-prompt/37-method study has another scope.
Small-subset size differs between data card and README; preserve uncertainty instead of choosing 50 or 60. No prompt/annotation export was acquired.

Two production Crossref records each contain publisher and Retraction Watch assertions in reverse directions: four appearances normalize to one notice and two assertions. Crossmark’s generic history label Correction does not override the retraction notice.
ReproHum values are 0–100 rating points and the original 86.47 is digitized. Two attempts ran in parallel despite different publication years; the overview is not a third human replication.
Individual reports give original zero-shot 69.71; the overview says 60.71. Keep unresolved, along with changed QRA/CV* conventions; the augmented-zero-shot chain is consistent.

Leakage-paper and supplement evidence is limited to indexed primary excerpts; the register and full primary text remain unavailable. Complete primary-paper inspection is not established and corrected AUCs remain null.
PRISM is an author-reported label failure and withdrawn version, with no verified independent replication or corrected score. Version-local rights and latest status stay separate.
METR repeats AP002: adjusted completion-time change, not a universal productivity ratio. Later intervals span zero with changed selection/time accounting. Paper v2 CC BY 4.0 does not clear code/CSV.
OpenAI’s 59.4% refers to selected 138/500 tasks. July 8, 2026 withdraws a Pro recommendation, not a journal paper; retain separate benchmark and review-path identities.
